name: launch_specialist
description: Launch an allowlisted Waykit specialist as a host subagent. Pass specialist id, capability class, and handover paths. For agent-review, agent-security, and agent-arch-drift set readonly true and pass handoverPath/diffRef only — never the implementation transcript. Do not launch stack profiles. Do not split TDD gear 1 and gear 2.

readonly.description: Must be true for audit specialists. No product file edits, no state-changing shell.

handoverPath.description: Primary handover the child may read (handover_tdd.md / handover_xfn.md). Never the implementation transcript.

diffRef.description: Git range or PR URL. Pass with handoverPath only.

handoverPaths.description: Handover files the child must read or write
